hooks.command:
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' ! -name 'README.md' ! -name 'CLAUDE.md' ! -name 'GETTING_STARTED.md' ! -name 'design.md' 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "Found non-critical markdown file: $(basename $f)"; done | if grep -q .; then echo '{"systemMessage": "📋 Non-critical .md files detected in root directory.

Consider moving to docs/ folder to keep root clean. These files should live in docs/:—— GITHUB_SETUP.md, MONGODB_VIEWING_GUIDE.md, etc.

Manage markdown files:"}'; fi

hooks.prompt: User is running a git commit. Before they proceed, ask: 'Before committing, have you updated CLAUDE.md to reflect your changes? Check: new commands, dependencies, patterns, or architecture updates.' If they confirm, respond with {"ok": true}. If unsure, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "User should update CLAUDE.md first"}.
